sources.snippet: Ultralytics YOLO11 is available through the official Ultralytics YOLO package. It supports object detection, instance segmentation, image classification, pose estimation, oriented object detection, and tracking in a fast, accurate, and easy to use Python and CLI workflow. This repository is a lightweight discovery page for YOLO11. The canonical implementation, package releases, model downloads ...

sources.title: PDF Real-Time AI-Based Personal Protective Equipment Detection and Safety ...
sources.snippet: The proposed PPE detection system is developed using the YOLO11s object detection model to provide real-time monitoring of worker safety at construction sites. The overall workflow begins with collecting and organizing the PPE dataset, followed by preprocessing to remove invalid or missing annotations and improve data quality.
